query:
SELECT
                        d.id AS "id!: models::Id",
                        d.created_at,
                        d.updated_at,
                        d.detail,
                        (
                            SELECT count(*)
                            FROM draft_specs ds
                            WHERE ds.draft_id = d.id
                              AND ds.catalog_name::text ^@ ANY($4)
                        ) AS "num_specs!"
                    FROM drafts d
                    WHERE d.user_id = $1
                      AND ($2::flowid IS NULL OR d.id > $2)
                    ORDER BY d.id ASC
                    LIMIT $3
